sealed: 2026-10-28 — committed BEFORE any measuring code (measure/measure.mjs, measure/judge.mjs) or tuning code (tools/tune.mjs) exists. Nothing under measure/ or tools/ except this file exists at the seal commit.
spec: Simon's BES LAYER, 2026-10-28: the fourth layer of the living defence — an attacker holding a VALID stolen key walks through verify-before-parse; BES asks 'are you behaving like yourself?'. Credential validity never overrides entropy violation.
credit: Method: Gary W. Floyd, Lumiea Systems Research Division — ThunderStruck Service LLC — "GEP-Based Security: Behavioral Entropy Signatures for Cybersecurity and DevOps," 2025 (CC BY 4.0), and "Bayesian Entropy Similarity (BES): Alignment Salience for Entropy-Regulated AI Systems," Technical Report, December 2025 (MIT, defensive prior art). Gary's production numbers (<0.1% false positives, 0 intrusions over 18 months) are HIS reported results; every number below is measured here, on this estate.

data.cutoff: 2026-10-28T18:00:00Z — events at or after this moment are never read

streams.simon: Simon's HUMAN actions: every turn he typed or pasted into Claude Code on this machine (transcript records with type 'user', origin.kind 'human', not isMeta, not a tool result, not a message another session sent). Each turn becomes one action: its time, its client surface (entrypoint), its project (working folder), a structural class and a size bucket computed locally from the text (the text itself is never stored), and the permission mode in force.
streams.kar-session: Kar's AGENT actions in working sessions: every tool call Kar made in Claude Code on this machine (assistant records' tool_use blocks): its time, the tool class (and for a shell call the first program named), the repo or area it touched, the input size bucket, the tier it routes to (code / local model / more cortex) and its privilege class (read / write / outward).
streams.kar-night: Kar's AGENT actions in the nightly loop: kar-experiments.json entries, the LIGHT call book calls.lcb, kar-rsi-honesty.jsonl runs and signals-delivered.json deliveries: time, step kind, tier/model class, size bucket.

data.privacy: All three streams are extracted on this machine into LIGHT-coded files under ~/.si-didy/bes/private/ and NEVER enter the repo, a commit, CI or a public page. Behavioural baselines stay in LIGHT on this device. Public receipts hold only counts, rates and verdict tallies, plus the SHA-256 of each private stream so the inputs cannot be swapped later. CI and the live page run the SYNTHETIC mirror only.

splits.formation: the first 14 days of each stream (Gary's ~2-week baseline formation) — OBSERVE-ONLY
splits.dev: from formation end to 2026-10-07T00:00:00Z — the only real data tuning may read
splits.test: 2026-10-07T00:00:00Z to the cutoff — read only by measure/measure.mjs, after seal 2. A stream whose formation ends after 2026-10-07 has no dev part; its test part starts when its formation ends.

seal2: Every numeric parameter (calibration quantiles and multipliers, smoothing, window, gradient and session-budget scales) is tuned by tools/tune.mjs on the DEV split and the SYNTHETIC mirror only, then frozen in params.json at a commit that precedes the first run of measure/measure.mjs on test. Tuning objective, fixed now: on dev, a false-positive rate at most 0.5% (half the B4/B5 bar) for simon and kar-session, then the most driver sessions caught on dev. The structure of the decision (the two papers' tables, the estate's identity rules) is NOT tuned.

definitions.verdicts: ALLOW < THROTTLE < STEP_UP < BLOCK < ISOLATE (Gary's five). Claims are judged on Gary's RAW verdict (before the estate's enforcement mapping) unless a claim says 'enforced'.
definitions.falsePositive: a genuine post-formation action of the stream's own identity whose raw verdict is STEP_UP, BLOCK or ISOLATE
definitions.session: an injected run of 30 actions under one identity's key, started from that identity's watcher state at the injection moment (real history up to then, nothing after)
definitions.injections: 20 moments evenly spaced across the identity's test period; the action shapes of each session are drawn with a fixed seed from that identity's REAL test actions
definitions.caughtWithin10: at least one of the session's first 10 actions reaches the claim's verdict

drivers.cadence: the real shapes re-timed to a fixed 60-second interval, starting at the injection moment
drivers.burst: the real shapes re-timed 500 ms apart
drivers.uniform: the real shapes in a random order at independent uniformly random moments across the 24 hours after the injection moment
drivers.shuffled: the real shapes with their real gaps but their order shuffled (wrong step order)
drivers.borrowed: the real shapes of one identity re-timed with the OTHER identity's real gaps, starting at a real start moment of that other identity
drivers.mimic: the identity's own real actions from exactly 7 days before the injection moment, replayed with their exact gaps and hours (a perfect copy of a past week — Gary's A.2 'mimicry')

definitions.note: Every driver only re-times or re-orders legitimate recorded request shapes. None is a new attack tool.

B1.says: Simon's stolen key replayed from a script is blocked or stepped up.
B1.rule: for each driver in [cadence, burst, uniform] on stream simon: at least 19 of 20 sessions caughtWithin10 at STEP_UP or above

B2.says: Kar's stolen key driven by a script (wrong structure) is blocked.
B2.rule: for each driver in [cadence, burst, uniform, shuffled] on each of kar-session and kar-night: at least 19 of 20 sessions caughtWithin10 at BLOCK or ISOLATE

B3.says: Kar acting outside its signed delegation envelope is blocked even with a perfect baseline.
B3.rule: 20 real kar-session test actions, each judged with Kar's watcher ALLOWing it, under each of 9 envelope faults [out-of-scope verb, over the wallet budget, before its window, after its expiry, revoked, a high-stakes verb (money / deal / public claim / reserved switch) with no live approval, signed by a key that is not Simon's, body tampered after signing, a live approval whose words changed]: the trust verdict is BLOCK in 180 of 180; and the same 20 actions inside a valid envelope pass the envelope stage 20 of 20

B4.says: Simon's real irregular behaviour stays under the sealed false-positive bar.
B4.rule: falsePositive rate over every simon test action at most 1.0%

B5.says: Kar's real nightly loop stays under the same bar — not flagged for its own regularity.
B5.rule: falsePositive rate over every kar-night test action at most 1.0%, and over every kar-session test action at most 1.0%

B6.says: Mixed signals are stepped up or blocked.
B6.rule: (a) simon shapes under the 'borrowed' driver with kar-night's timing: at least 19 of 20 sessions caughtWithin10 at STEP_UP or above; (b) kar-session shapes under 'borrowed' with simon's timing: at least 19 of 20 caughtWithin10 at STEP_UP or above; (c) every real kar-session test action that is inside a valid envelope but whose raw verdict from Kar's watcher is THROTTLE or above gets a trust verdict of STEP_UP or above (all of them, counted)

B7.says: Nothing is blocked while a baseline forms, and the offline recovery path works.
B7.rule: (a) every formation-period action of all three streams has ENFORCED verdict ALLOW (raw verdicts recorded but not enforced); (b) for each of the 3 identities (simon, kar-session, kar-night) put into BLOCK: a recovery record signed by the offline recovery key returns it to observe-only; the same record signed by the daily key is refused; a replayed recovery record is refused; a tampered one is refused — 12 of 12

L1.says: A PREDICTED LIMIT (Gary's own A.2: 'Mimicry Attack … BES doesn't protect against this'): a perfect copy of Simon's own past week is not reliably caught.
L1.rule: prediction: fewer than 10 of 20 'mimic' sessions on stream simon are caughtWithin10 at STEP_UP or above. If 10 or more are caught the prediction FAILED (BES did better than its author says) and that is reported as measured.

S.says: The synthetic mirror — the only thing CI and the live page run.
S.rule: B1–B7 and L1, same procedures and bars, on the seeded synthetic streams (src/synth.mjs); CI re-derives receipts/synthetic.json byte for byte

outcomes: A claim that fails stays failed and is shown as failed on the page and in the receipt. No rule, bar, split or driver above changes after this commit; a later fix gets new claims sealed before its code.
scope: Single operator plus one agent. Complements, never replaces, encryption, patching and verify-before-parse. No defence against physical compromise of the device. Not intent detection, not malware detection, not surveillance — stability regulation (Gary §8).
